hardQuoteObservations.preregisteredQuote: Sukiyaki (Japanese sweet soy hotpot), Yakiniku (Japanese BBQ)
Kotaro Lunch ◆ Sukiyaki Set (Strip Loin, 1 slice)

A special sukiyaki featuring one carefully selected strip loin, seared on a traditional Nambu cast-iron pan. Koshihikari rice from Niigata, light, fluffy meringue-style egg, umami-rich special dashi broth, a satisfying Gozen set served with pickles.
Kotaro Tasting Lunch ◆ Sukiyaki Set (Spencer roll 1 slice, Strip loin 1 slice)

Rich Spencer roll, and a Strip loin with a beautiful balance of lean and fat. A luxurious tasting Gozen set featuring both cuts grilled on Nambu cast-iron. The sweetness of the fat and the meat’s natural savor. Enjoy the distinct character of each slice. Served with Niigata Koshihikari rice, a fluffy meringue-style egg, a flavorful special dashi soup, and pickles — a Manzoku Gozen set.
